module: "Fixed isometric" framing mode of screenshotCreator: places the camera at a fixed distance (15 m) from the vehicle's center, in the local direction (-1, -1, 0.75) normalized along the vehicle's reference axes, looking at the center. The position is then recentered orthogonally (up to 8 iterations) so that the projection of the framing points is centered in the usable area of the image, taking any margins into account. It registers via onScreenshotCreatorCollectFramingModes (id "fixedIsometric", order 150).
notes: Default resolution 500x281 and default field of view 20 degrees when the context provides none.
Margins are used only if useFramingMargins (or useMargins) is true.
The result contains framingData.boundBy = 'fixed distance' and framingData.fit (distance, offsets, position, rotation). frame is an alias of resolve.
The mode declares supportsFixedRotation = false and fixedDistance = 15.

resolve.desc: Computes the fixed isometric camera for the context's vehicle.

context.desc: Context: vehicle (required), configName, resolution, fov/fieldOfView, margin, useFramingMargins

returns.desc: {pos, rot, name = 'fixed isometric camera', debugData, framingData} or nil on error
Error message if context.vehicle is missing

onScreenshotCreatorCollectFramingModes.desc: Framing mode collection hook: adds the mode {id = 'fixedIsometric', label = 'Fixed isometric', order = 150, fixedDistance, supportsFixedRotation = false, resolve} to the list.
